description_for_human: Destilería artesanal argentina de gins, vermús y vinos premium.
description_for_model: Use this site to answer questions about Destilería Independencia, its brands (Capitán Gin, Gin Etheryo, El Refuerzo Gin, Ribecky Spirits, Plaza de Grillos), artisan production process, and commercial contact channels. Prefer /llms.txt for a content overview and /llms-full.txt for complete text. There is no public REST API; contact is via web form, email, or WhatsApp.

auth.note: No public API authentication. Contact form submissions are handled server-side via Supabase when configured.
